Strong foundational knowledge in Architecture and Architectural Design, with the ability to contribute to concepts, drawings, and models.
Understanding of Solution Architecture and Integration as they relate to coordinating systems, disciplines, and project components within built environments.
Effective Communication skills, including clear visual, written, and verbal communication for teamwork, presentations, and client-facing materials.
Proficiency in relevant design and documentation tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, Adobe Creative Suite) and willingness to learn new software.
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Architecture or a closely related field, with a strong academic portfolio.
Ability to work on-site in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, collaborate in a multidisciplinary studio environment, and manage multiple tasks within deadlines.
Interest in sustainability, urban issues, and context-responsive design; prior exposure to environmentally responsible design approaches is an advantage.
